common_name: Morning-Glory Flower-Breeding Fly (Apical Melanic Wing Patch & Courtship Semaphore)
phenomenon: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength at the subcellular detail scale

state_variables.u: short-range activator (melanin precursor / Yellow-pathway product), concentration

boundary_conditions: periodic on a flat apical-wing epithelial rectangle; no-flux is not used because the patch is an interior sample of a larger blade

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg 1979: f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.pde: dt u = f + Du laplacian u; dt v = g + Dv laplacian v
equations.jacobian: fu = -1 + 2 u v, fv = u^2, gu = -2 u v, gv = -u^2
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv fu + Du gv) / (2 Du Dv) at onset
equations.fastest_wavenumber: k_max = argmax Re sigma(k), sigma from det(J - k^2 D - sigma I) = 0
equations.onset_ratio: (r fu + gv)^2 = 4 r det J, r = Dv/Du

parameters.note: Slot-3182 kinetics. Not the textbook (0.10, 0.90) pair and not the slot-2801 101 µm power-law stub.
parameters.Du_policy: Solved at the elegans ratio so the linear fastest wavelength equals 1.803 µm. Deflecta and erecta keep that Du and change only r.

empirical_claims.claim: Male D. elegans and D. gunungcola differ in apical wing melanin and in courtship. The patch is a species-specific semaphore, not a generic cuticle stain.
Wing spots and the mating display that uses them are genetically separable.
Repeated wing-spot gains in Drosophila track cis-regulatory changes at the pleiotropic pigment gene yellow.
A homogeneous chemically stable state can be destabilized by diffusion at a finite critical wavenumber.

reported_in_source: D. elegans males have an apical melanic wing patch genetically tied to, but separable from, courtship behavior.
Turing 1952 dispersion relation and Schnakenberg 1979 two-species kinetics.
reconstructed_in_script: The 1.8 µm figure is the assigned detail-scale wavelength. Diffusivities are solved so the linear fastest mode equals that wavelength at r/r_c = 1.06.
Deflecta (2.195 µm class) and erecta (1.940 µm class) wavelengths are the same law at fixed Du with r/r_c = 2.65 and 1.48.
transfer_boundary: Yeh and Massey compare elegans with gunungcola. Deflecta and erecta enter only as the campaign chronoseries neighbors (11/41), not as measured sister species.
does_not_claim: Does not claim the macro photograph resolves a 1.8 µm lattice.
Does not claim a published measurement of melanin-granule spacing in D. deflecta or D. erecta.
Does not claim the organ-scale spot diameter (slot 2801, ~101 µm).
